sources.text: Hi, I'm Harry! I’m learning AI, Machine Learning and Data Science, and sharing everything I pick up along the way. I’ve found the most helpful lessons often come from someone just one step ahead. So, wherever you are in your journey, you’ll find videos here that break these topics down in a way that’s easy to follow and understand.

Best GitHub repos for learning AI, Machine Learning and Data Science. These include practical resources, books and hands-on projects to build real-world skills.

#ai #machinelearning #datascience

Learn how to implement a Decision Tree from scratch in Python using just math and NumPy (no machine learning libraries like Scikit-Learn). I’ll start by explaining the intuition and core math concepts behind Decision Trees, including Entropy, Gini Impurity and Information Gain, and then walk through how to turn that into code. 
This is Episode 5 of my Machine Learning From Scratch series, where I’m building ML algorithms from the ground up, step-by-step to truly understand how they work under the hood.

📺 Watch the playlist here: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLh6JMkwECi5HXVJ58ue58jJvL599NFYja
📊 Kaggle Dataset: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/uciml/iris

#python #machinelearning

The essential python skills you need in artificial intelligence and machine learning, including libraries like NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Scikit-Learn and PyTorch. In this video, I break down why you should learn python for AI/ML, then walk you through the core python concepts you need to know, giving you a clear roadmap for your own studies. I’ll also share the free resources that helped me along the way.

#python #ai #machinelearning #datascience

Learn how to implement a Naive Bayes Classifier from scratch in Python using just math and NumPy (no machine learning libraries like Scikit-Learn). I’ll start by explaining the core math concepts behind Naive Bayes, including the Bayes Theorem and the Gaussian Distribution to deal with continuous features, and then walk through how to turn that into code.
This is Episode 4 of my Machine Learning From Scratch series, where I’m building ML algorithms from the ground up, step-by-step to truly understand how they work under the hood.

#machinelearning #python

Learn how to implement the K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) algorithm from scratch in Python using just math and NumPy (no machine learning libraries like Scikit-Learn). I’ll start by explaining the intuition and core math concepts behind KNN, including the euclidian distance and majority voting, and then walk through how to turn this into code.
This is Episode 3 of my Machine Learning From Scratch series, where I’m building ML algorithms from the ground up, step-by-step to truly understand how they work under the hood.

#machinelearning #python

Learn how to implement a Logistic Regression model in Python using just math and NumPy (no machine learning libraries like Scikit-Learn). I’ll walk through the core math behind logistic regression, including the sigmoid function, decision boundaries, and the cost function, and then show how to turn those equations into code.
This is Episode 2 of my Machine Learning From Scratch series, where I’m building ML algorithms from the ground up, step-by-step to truly understand how they work under the hood.

Welcome to The Programmers Realm! 🚀

Dive into the world of coding and technology with me, where we explore the essentials of Python programming, web development, networking and anything computers! Whether you're a beginner taking your first steps or an advanced programmer looking to refine your skills, we've got something for everyone ✨

What's your coding goal? Share your thoughts and projects in the comments, and let's build the future together! 🌐💻

#Python #Programming #WebDevelopment #Networking #LearnToCode #TheProgrammersRealm #CodingForBeginners #WebDevelopment #Code #vscode #javascript #networking #network  #webdevelopment #webseries 

A "TFR" brand.

Learn how to import and use modules to add extra functionalities to your code! 🚀

Python Module Index - Builtin (https://docs.python.org/3/py-modindex.html)
Python Package Index - Community (https://pypi.org/)



Don't forget to like, subscribe, and leave a comment on what you want to learn next! 🔥

Join me in the PROGRAMMER'S REALM!

#Python #Programming #PythonTutorial #LearnToCode #CodingForBeginners #TheProgrammersRealm

Avoid program crashes and make your code more reliable with this essential Python skill. Use try-except!

(Yeah, I have a new keyboard - pretty cool, right?)

Hate listening and prefer reading? Here's a blog post I made:
https://blog.joeymanani.com/why-catching-all-exceptions-is-a-bad-idea-in-python



Don't forget to like, subscribe, and leave a comment on what you want to learn next! 🔥

Join me in the PROGRAMMER'S REALM!

🎵 Onoychenkomusic - Bossa Jazz Summer


#Python #Programming #PythonTutorial #LearnToCode #CodingForBeginners #TheProgrammersRealm

Learn how to handle date and time data with ease. I'll teach you how to get the current date, the current time, a previous/future timestamp as well as formatting a timestamp for human readability 🚀

Count how many times (pun not intended) I say "date" and "time" in this video, leave a comment. I realized how silly my script sounds now that I've actually made the video - there's no better substitute for the words though.

Whoops, forgot to leave a comment at the top of the code which says what video this is, maybe the module import makes it obvious enough 🥲



Don't forget to like, subscribe, and leave a comment on what you want to learn next! 🔥

Join me in the PROGRAMMER'S REALM!

#Python #Programming #PythonTutorial #LearnToCode #CodingForBeginners #TheProgrammersRealm

sources.text:
Aprende Machine Learning con Python. Nuevo video cada semana.

Creado por Javier Ontiveros.

Entra a pyninja.pro y comienza a aprender Machine Learning hoy mismo.

En este video, explicaremos en detalle cómo funciona la ecuación normal y cómo utilizar la librería Scikit-Learn para entrenar un modelo de regresión lineal simple.

#inteligenciaartificial #machinelearning #ecuacion #normal #scikit #learn

Más videos:
Gradiente descendente mini-batch | Machine Learning 101 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B13_noZP_O8&t=1s 
Gradiente descendente estocástico | Machine Learning 101 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PDOVKZZ3_qU 
Función de coste: Error Cuadrático Medio | Machine Learning 101 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lkGyu70gAzE&t=22s

Temas del video:
- Inteligencia artificial
- Machine learning
- Ecuación normal
- Scikit-learn
- Regresión lineal simple

Sígueme en:
Twitter: https://twitter.com/pyninja_

Contacto:
pyninja.official@gmail.com
Acerca de pyninja:
pyninja es una plataforma (https://pyninja.io/) y un canal de YouTube (https://youtube.com/@pyninja) especializado en la producción de contenido educativo sobre Machine Learning con Python. Nos enfocamos en proporcionar recursos en español mediante video tutoriales y cursos para facilitar el aprendizaje.

Capítulos:
00:00 - Intro
00:39 - Regresión lineal simple con la ecuación normal
02:00 - Regresión lineal simple con scikit-learn
03:20 - Complejidad temporal de la ecuación normal
04:54 - Complejidad temporal de scikit-learn
06:11 - Implementación en Python
13:27 - Outro
